This selection changes only the Apple ad: This selection changes only the Apple adapter configuration and is saved per instance.
How often supported Apple devices are re: How often supported Apple devices are rediscovered and unavailable active devices are retried.
Apple Account access is not configured y: Apple Account access is not configured yet. Credentials will only be added after the authorization and secure-storage contract has been defined.
For reliable discovery, please make sure: For reliable discovery, please make sure that all devices are switched on.
Start pairing for one Apple TV, enter th: Start pairing for one Apple TV, enter the four-digit PIN displayed by that device, and finish or cancel the operation in the same row. The PIN is never saved.
Select an Apple TV, start pairing, enter: Select an Apple TV, start pairing, enter the four-digit PIN shown on the TV, and finish pairing. The PIN is never saved.
Four digits currently displayed by the s: Four digits currently displayed by the selected Apple TV.
Active devices connect and receive an io: Active devices connect and receive an ioBroker object tree. Passive devices retain their local pairing but are disconnected and removed from the object tree.
Set the selected device passive and remo: Set the selected device passive and remove its ioBroker object tree?
Remove the selected device from local ma: Remove the selected device from local management and delete its ioBroker object tree? If it is still detected, it will return to the detected-devices list.
Only active managed devices receive an i: Only active managed devices receive an ioBroker object tree. Passive devices remain in local management without a device tree.
Forgetting a device deletes its local pa: Forgetting a device deletes its local pairing credentials and complete ioBroker object tree. The controller entry can remain on the Apple TV until it is removed in tvOS settings.
Really delete the selected local pairing: Really delete the selected local pairing and its complete object tree?
No unmanaged HomePods with stable identi: No unmanaged HomePods with stable identity detected
Activate a detected HomePod to create it: Activate a detected HomePod to create its object tree and start automatic transient pairing. No PIN or HomePod credential is stored.
Strongly identified HomePods connect aut: Strongly identified HomePods connect automatically with transient pairing; no PIN or stored HomePod credential is required. Playback and volume controls appear in the object tree only after the device reports the matching capability. This preview still requires volunteer hardware validation.
No unmanaged AirPlay receivers with stab: No unmanaged AirPlay receivers with stable identity detected
Activate a detected AirPlay receiver to: Activate a detected AirPlay receiver to create its read-only discovery object tree. Playback and streaming are not enabled by this setting.
AirPlay Receiver management will be adde: AirPlay Receiver management will be added after its stable identity and device contract have been validated.
Apple Music is planned as a separate con: Apple Music is planned as a separate content service for authorization, catalog, library, playlists, recommendations, and search. No credentials or runtime objects are created yet.
